verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage provides an API for reviewing and remediating cases, alerts and risks outside the web app, plus case filtering and audit trails, so an agent can pull flagged cases with context. Its own agentic workflows (a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent) auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk cases to humans. However, nothing documents an agent producing evidence summaries or a recommended decision that a human then confirms. missing for 10: documented evidence summarization per case, a recommend-then-human-confirm decision flow (as opposed to auto-remediation or escalation), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the review queue — pull flagged cases with their context, summarize the evidence, and recommend a decision for a human to confirm

citations.quote: Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
